paper.title_en: Curvature-induced scalarization of charged AdS black holes
paper.abstract_en: We investigate how a negative cosmological constant affects the Gauss-Bonnet (GB) scalarization in the Einstein-Maxwell-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet theory with a scalar coupling constant $η$ to GB term. We focus on the instability of Reissner-Nordström-AdS (RN-AdS) black holes under a scalar perturbation governed by an effective mass $μ^2_{\text{eff}}$ sourced by the GB term. Unlike the asymptotically flat spacetime case, the onset of scalarization is not merely determined by $μ^2_{\text{eff}} < 0$, but it is constrained by the Breitenlohner-Freedman (BF) bound. In case that the BF bound is violated ($η>2.25$ with $Λ=-0.5$), one may find AdS-tachyonic instability. We find that for $0<η<2.25$, the GB$^+$ scalarization may be performed through spontaneous scalarization, while for $η<0$ the GB$^-$ scalarization is found to give the single branch of scalarized AdS black holes. For the GB$^+$ scalarization in $η_{th}\leη<2.25$ with $η_{th}$ threshold instability, we obtain the single branch ($n=0$ fundamental branch) of scalarized AdS black holes, in contrast to the infinite branches in asymptotically flat spacetime. A bulk fixed-charge thermodynamic analysis is performed thoroughly for GB$^\pm$ scalarizations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨了负宇宙常数对高斯-博内特效应的标量化的影响，涉及反德西特黑洞的不稳定性和热力学，属于黑洞热力学与广义相对论基础相关领域。
decision.title_zh: 带电反德西特黑洞的曲率诱导标量化
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了负宇宙常数如何影响爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-标量-高斯-博内特理论中与高斯-博内特项耦合的标量耦合常数$η$的高斯-博内特标量化。我们关注的是由高斯-博内特项产生的有效质量$μ^2_{\text{eff}}$所控制的标量扰动下Reissner-Nordström-AdS黑洞的不稳定性。与渐近平直时空的情况不同，标量化的起始不仅仅由$μ^2_{\text{eff}} < 0$决定，还受到Breitenlohner-Freedman束缚的限制。在BF束缚被违反的情况下（$Λ=-0.5$时$η>2.25$），可能会出现AdS-超光速不稳定性。我们发现对于$0<η<2.25$，GB$^+$标量化可以通过自发标量化进行，而对于$η<0$，GB$^-$标量化被发现给出标量化AdS黑洞的单分支。对于$η_{th}\leη<2.25$（$η_{th}$为阈值不稳定性）的GB$^+$标量化，我们得到标量化AdS黑洞的单分支（$n=0$基态分支），这与渐近平直时空中的无穷多分支形成对比。我们对GB$^\pm$标量化进行了彻底的体固定电荷热力学分析。
